title.zh: 【Specter：币安攻击者已通过 Relay 跨链桥转移约 3800 万美元资金】
title.en: 【Specter：币安攻击者已通过 Relay 跨链桥转移约 3800 万美元资金】

current_state.zh: On-chain analyst Specter reports that the Binance attacker moved approximately $38 million through the Relay cross-chain bridge over seven hours despite Relay's deployed KYT monitoring, and questioned whether North Korean hackers could have moved similar volume via THORChain, casting doubt on Relay's compliance and risk controls.
